reviews.comment: For biochemical calculations, Dr. Kunkel is a good professor. It's really a math class, so the problem sets are gonna be your main focus, but his lectures aren't bad, and he goes through everything he expects you to know, and he never tested over anything not specifically discussed in class or on a problem set. He'll usually answer questions, too

Dr. Kunkel is a very straightforward professor and tells you what he's looking for; come to class, pay attention, and make sure you know the objectives that he puts on eCampus before the test, and you'll be fine. He wants everyone to do well. His lectures can be hard to pay attention to, and I did find myself kind of falling asleep sometimes

He's a nice guy and gives fairly useful lectures, but I could not stay awake during his class. His voice is too soothing. Also, tests were very annoying because they draw from all the slides, so I felt I had no idea what I would be tested on. There is no homework so if you take him you should be able to study independently.
made class hard will never take him first time teaching made class very boring

reviews.comment: bad professor made the class hard gives very hard exams. would not take him

This class isn't the most difficult class ever. Kunkel still made it interesting by relating the math concepts to actual experiments. Great at lecturing. Only complaint is how his ppts were set up. No use of equation editor, so the slides looked a little funky sometimes with large blocks of equations that were a little hard to read. Overall great

reviews.comment: very good prof for biochemical calculation 404 straight forward test exactly come from poverpoint made a very hard class into a very easy class best prof in biochem department

He taught the 2nd half of GENE302, and this was his first time teaching the course. He did a great job explaining the concepts and made everything very clear. Not a very difficult course. 4 quizzes that only cover most recent material, 2 exams that cover half the course. Gave out practice problem sets that were invaluable to study. Amazing prof
Tough course, you MUST study if you want a good grade in his course. But you will definitely learn the material. Dr Kunkel was very helpful during and after class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I was very excited at the beginning of the semester because Kunkel is animated during lectures and will answer questions. I realized quickly, however that the lectures do not prepare you for the exams. Exams are very tough. And, despite taking attendance every day, he does not award any extra credit or curve. I was blind-sighted with a C.
